component.name: TVTime

Label.text: Make sure the backend is running on your network.

component.script:
function init() m.top.setFocus(true) m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.headlineLabel = m.top.findNode("headlineLabel") m.detailLabel = m.top.findNode("detailLabel") m.minutesLabel = m.top.findNode("minutesLabel")
m.top.observeField("serverAddress", "onFieldChanged") m.top.observeField("timeRemaining", "onFieldChanged") m.top.observeField("dailyLimitMinutes", "onFieldChanged") m.top.observeField("error", "onFieldChanged") m.top.observeField("isLimitHit", "onFieldChanged") m.top.observeField("discovering", "onFieldChanged")
UpdateUI() end function
function UpdateUI() isLimitHit = m.top.isLimitHit hasError = m.top.error <> "" isDiscovering = m.top.discovering timeRemaining = m.top.timeRemaining dailyLimitMinutes = m.top.dailyLimitMinutes
if isDiscovering m.statusLabel.text = "Connecting to TV Time" m.statusLabel.color = "0x72D7EEFF" m.headlineLabel.text = "Searching for backend server..." m.headlineLabel.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.detailLabel.text = "Make sure the backend is running on your network." m.detailLabel.visible = true m.minutesLabel.visible = false else if hasError m.statusLabel.text = "Backend server not found" m.statusLabel.color = "0xFF6B6BFF" m.headlineLabel.text = "Cannot read TV limit" m.headlineLabel.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.detailLabel.text = m.top.error m.detailLabel.visible = true m.minutesLabel.visible = false else if isLimitHit m.statusLabel.text = "Daily TV limit reached" m.statusLabel.color = "0xFF6B6BFF" m.headlineLabel.text = "Time to turn the TV off" m.headlineLabel.color = "0xFF6B6BFF" if dailyLimitMinutes > 0 m.detailLabel.text = "Today's limit was " + dailyLimitMinutes.ToStr() + " minutes." else m.detailLabel.text = "No TV time remains today." end if m.detailLabel.visible = true m.minutesLabel.visible = false else m.statusLabel.text = "TV Time Remaining" m.statusLabel.color = "0x72D7EEFF" m.headlineLabel.text = "You have" m.headlineLabel.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" if m.top.serverAddress <> "" m.detailLabel.text = "Polling " + m.top.serverAddress + " every few seconds." else m.detailLabel.text = "The app checks the backend every few seconds." end if m.detailLabel.visible = true m.minutesLabel.visible = true m.minutesLabel.text = timeRemaining.ToStr() + " minutes"
if timeRemaining > 30 m.minutesLabel.color = "0x00FF00FF" ' Green else if timeRemaining > 10 m.minutesLabel.color = "0xFFA500FF" ' Orange else m.minutesLabel.color = "0xFF0000FF" ' Red end if end if end function
function onFieldChanged(msg as object) as void UpdateUI() end function
